reviews.comment: Overall, she was a very ok professor. Lectures are her reading off of a slideshow and you copying down notes. To get the higher A in the class, read the textbook, otherwise you might be fighting for an A. If you don't read it, you'll still pass exams. Homework does help balance the tests out and overall the class is low time commitment.
Easy to do well in the class, even though the exams are challenging. Homeworks are frequent, but guaranteed 100s which help counteract the exams. Professor is nice but not very engaging.
